tools.name: ambr_list_templates
tools.description:
List available contract templates on Ambr.

Returns all active Ricardian Contract templates with their slugs, names, descriptions,
categories, parameter schemas, and pricing. Use this to discover which templates are
available before creating a contract with ambr_create_contract.

No authentication r

tools.name: ambr_create_contract
tools.description:
Generate a Ricardian Contract from a template.

Creates a dual-format contract (human-readable legal text + machine-parsable JSON)
using AI, linked by SHA-256 hash. The contract is stored on Ambr and accessible
via the Reader Portal.

Requires a valid API key (X-API-Key header on the HTTP request) w

tools.name: ambr_get_contract
tools.description:
Retrieve a contract by ID, SHA-256 hash, or UUID.

With a valid API key (contract creator): returns the full contract including
human-readable text, machine-readable JSON, status, and principal declaration.
Without authentication: returns metadata only (contract_id, status, hash, dates).

Supports t

tools.name: ambr_get_contract_status
tools.description:
Check the status of a contract and its amendment chain.

Returns the current status and any linked amendments (parent or child contracts).
Useful for verifying if a contract is active, amended, or terminated.

Args:
  - id (string, required): Contract ID, SHA-256 hash, or UUID

Returns:
  - contract

tools.name: ambr_verify_hash
tools.description:
Verify a contract's SHA-256 hash to confirm document integrity.

Checks whether the provided hash matches a contract stored on Ambr. Returns
verification status, contract metadata, and Reader Portal URL if found.

Args:
  - hash (string, required): SHA-256 hash (64-character hex string)

Returns:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ambr_create_contract · Private data: ambr_create_contract, ambr_get_contract, ambr_verify_hash, ambr_agent_handshake · Public sink: ambr_create_contract · Destructive: ambr_list_templates, ambr_create_contract, ambr_get_contract, ambr_get_contract_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ambr_create_contract · Private data: ambr_create_contract, ambr_get_contract, ambr_verify_hash, ambr_agent_handshake · Public sink: ambr_create_contract · Destructive: ambr_list_templates, ambr_create_contract, ambr_get_contract, ambr_get_contract_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ambr_create_contract" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
